en.headline: HK Electric cuts October fuel charge; CLP raises its rate
en.dek: Hongkong Electric will charge 59.3 cents per unit for fuel in October, down 1.4 cents, while CLP’s fuel adjustment rises 1.1 cents to 46.2 cents.
body: Hongkong Electric announced on Friday that its October fuel adjustment charge will be 59.3 cents per unit, 1.4 cents lower than in September. Including the basic tariff, the average net tariff will be 187.2 cents per unit, a drop of 0.8 percent from the previous month.

The company said the monthly mechanism has a deferred effect, so the October figure mainly reflects fuel costs from June to August. It noted that international energy prices remain volatile and future adjustments will depend on market movements. Hongkong Electric said it would continue to monitor markets and adjust its fuel mix to keep supply stable while limiting the impact of price swings on customers.
The utility is maintaining a special electricity subsidy of 8 cents per unit for residential customers using 450 units or less per month through October.
CLP Power said its October fuel adjustment will rise 1.1 cents to 46.2 cents per unit. Its average net tariff will be 147.4 cents per unit.

zh.headline: 港燈10月燃料調整費下調1.4仙 中電上調1.1仙
zh.dek: 港燈10月燃料調整費每度電59.3仙，較9月下調1.4仙；中電則上調1.1仙至46.2仙。
body: 港燈周五公布，10月份燃料調整費為每度電59.3仙，較9月下調1.4仙。連同基本電費，10月平均淨電費為每度電187.2仙，較9月減少0.8%。
港燈發言人表示，燃料調整費按月調整機制存在遞延效應，10月數字主要反映今年6月至8月的燃料成本。發言人指國際能源市場價格仍然波動，未來水平仍取決於燃料價格走勢。港燈會繼續監察市場，透過審慎採購及調整燃料組合，在保障供應穩定及符合排放上限的同時，盡量減低價格波動對客戶的影響。
港燈在8月至10月期間，繼續向每月用電量450度或以下的住宅客戶提供每度電8仙的特別電費補助。
中電方面，10月燃料調整費為每度電46.2仙，較9月上調1.1仙，平均淨電費為每度電147.4仙。
